title: 2020 HMMT November General Problem 1
statement: In the Cartesian plane, a line segment with midpoint \((2020,11)\) has one endpoint at \((a, 0)\) and the other endpoint on the line \(y=x\). Compute \(a\).

solutions.text: Let the other endpoint be \((t, t)\). The midpoint of \((a, 0)\) and \((t, t)\) is \(\left(\frac{a+t}{2}, \frac{t}{2}\right)\). So, we know that \(\frac{a+t}{2}=2020\) and \(\frac{t}{2}=11\). The second equation yields \(t=22\). Substituting this into the first yields \(a=2 \cdot 2020-22=4018\).
